description: Autonomous multi-agent multi-project orchestrator wrapper. Coordinates serial execution across subprojects using LangGraph, Docker containerization, and ephemeral Git workspaces.

tasks.title: Secrets & Environment Key Management Architecture
requirements: Define .env.example documenting runtime keys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
Implement .shared_orchestrator/config.py to validate and load credentials safely at runtime.
Ensure credential forwarding logic can inject environment variables into Docker containers without persisting secrets to images or git.

tasks.title: Dockerfile for Python / PDM Development
requirements: Create docker/pdm/Dockerfile with Python 3.12+, PDM, Git, and jq.
Verify build and executable availability (pdm --version, jq --version, git --version).
Include non-root user matching host UID/GID to avoid permission collisions during volume mounting.

tasks.title: Dockerfile for Firebase & Full-Stack Node Projects
requirements: Create docker/firebase/Dockerfile with Node.js LTS, npm, Firebase CLI (firebase-tools), Java JRE (for emulator suite), Git, and jq.
Validate that firebase --version and Java runtime run cleanly in headless mode.

tasks.title: Dockerfile for Android Projects
requirements: Create docker/android/Dockerfile with OpenJDK 17, Android SDK Command-line Tools (cmdline-tools, platform-tools, platforms, build-tools), Gradle, Git, and jq.
Verify headless ./gradlew check and SDK licenses acceptance.

tasks.title: Create PDM Agent Guide (docs/pdm.AGENTS.md)
requirements: Define PDM project conventions: dependency resolution, virtualenvs, pdm run pytest, linting, and formatting.
Document container mount commands and workspace isolation patterns.

tasks.title: Create Firebase Agent Guide (docs/firebase.AGENTS.md)
requirements: Document Firebase architecture: Cloud Functions, Firestore Security Rules, hosting, and local emulator execution (firebase emulators:exec).
Detail deterministic test strategies against emulators without external network calls.

tasks.title: Create Android Agent Guide (docs/android.AGENTS.md)
requirements: Document Android conventions: Gradle build lifecycle, Robolectric unit tests, linting, and headless validation.
Specify expected build directories and artifact paths.

tasks.title: Core Execution Tools for Orchestrator
requirements: Implement LangChain tool definitions in .shared_orchestrator/tools/.
file_tools.py: Read file, write/edit file atomically.
bash_tools.py: Execute shell commands with timeout handling.
git_tools.py: Branch/worktree creation, commit, diff inspection.
docker_tools.py: Execute task commands inside the appropriate Docker container.

tasks.title: Multi-Model Provider Harness & Role Prompt Engine
requirements: Implement model factory in .shared_orchestrator/models.py supporting Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Gemini using standard LangChain interfaces.
Dynamically load role definitions from .shared_orchestrator/roles/*.md and format system messages.
Bind corresponding tools to code_writer and reviewer.

tasks.title: Ephemeral Workspace Lifecycle Manager
requirements: Implement workspace manager to provision ephemeral Git worktrees for assigned tasks.
Coordinate container mounting for the ephemeral worktree.
Handle clean teardown and merging upon reviewer approval.

tasks.title: Production LangGraph StateGraph Implementation
requirements: Replace stubs in .shared_orchestrator/graph.py with real agent invocations.
Ensure code_writer runs autonomously with tool-calling loop until validation passes.
Implement reviewer running automated test commands inside container, checking git diff, and setting done or incrementing attempt count up to circuit breaker (3 attempts).

tasks.title: End-to-End Autonomous Execution Validation
requirements: Run an end-to-end autonomous execution test on a sample task.
Verify full transition from pending -> in_progress -> review -> done with zero human intervention.
